title: A differentiability framework for zigzag persistent homology via linear interpolation
summary: Persistent homology can be differentiated and incorporated into learning pipelines, but no analogous framework exists for zigzag persistence, which is needed when the underlying topological structure evolves non-monotonically over time. We develop such a framework for sequences of simplicial complexes obtained by thresholding time-dependent filtering values on a fixed complex. By assigning persistence diagram endpoints the real-valued times at which linearly interpolated filtering values cross the threshold, we transfer the continuity of the filtering values to the diagram points.
